registration: Written before this study's computation; within-session registration, not an external timestamped preregistration.
question: Which fixed existing signed tensors and source phases support the prepared activation guide, and do a bounded set of unprepared seeds exactly translate?
allowed_changes: one of eight preselected existing body-sign tensors
dynamics: Unchanged Engine.advance; no intervention during trajectories.

guide.opposite_source: channel 14 has negated a,b with r=2

readouts.arrival: First t>=0 with channel-0 b != 0 at each receiver j=1..N
readouts.click: A sampled 0-to-1 edge of the same local M_j
readouts.active_front_family: all first arrivals equal j+delay for one common delay in {0,1}
readouts.full_inverse: Each step rewinds exactly and final complete trajectory rewinds to initial.

guide.controls: For each tensor, N24 with no source, no guide, or receiver pair j=3 omitted; source_ab=[0,1].
guide.boundary: Side 151 and origin [60,75,75] give no causal boundary crossing through the longest 40-update run.

compact_search.translation_set: All nonzero coordinate-axis shifts of lengths 1 or 2 (12 shifts), periodic full-state equality including remainders
compact_search.success: At t=1..12 the entire nonempty retained state equals the initial state translated by one registered nonzero shift; support count must also match.
compact_search.failure: No certificate in this finite motif/sign/time/shift domain; not a no-go theorem.

budget_policy: Any exceeded limit is inconclusive; retain completed cases and report exact incomplete case. No failure counts inferred for unexecuted cases.
provenance: Store protocol and script SHA-256, all engine source SHA-256, fixed coupling fingerprints, complete deterministic preparation generators and initial/final state digests.
